verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a Research Agent that takes a question at a chosen effort level and pulls from a wide range of sources. It also documents automatic research reports generated from any research question, and an API mode that runs a full systematic review end to end (search, screening, extraction, reporting), which is clearly more than a single-pass summary. Community reports criticize accuracy but do not show that the multi-step investigation fails to run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the agent's autonomous step planning and iteration, and independent hands-on corroboration of the multi-step investigation depth.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Every Research Agent session runs at an effort level, which you set from the slider in the prompt box before you send your question.
the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need
Enter any research question in Elicit to generate a research-backed report!
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
